title: solanum stramoniifolium var. inerme
intro: Solanum stramoniifolium var. inerme, commonly known as Wolf's-bane or Stramonium, is a plant species belonging to the Solanaceae family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating various health conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Solanum stramoniifolium var. inerme include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include alkaloids like scopolamine and hyoscyamine, as well as flavonoids and phenolic acids, that provide sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects.
